description: This file provides shell script functions that act as compatibility wrappers for the /sbin/uci command used in OpenWrt. It includes functions to load, set defaults, revert, modify, and commit UCI configurations, enabling easier scripting and automation of configuration management in OpenWrt environments.

methods.name: uci_load
methods.description: Loads UCI configuration data for a given package into environment variables, optionally applies a callback if defined.

methods.name: uci_set_default
methods.description: Sets default configuration for a package if it is not already configured.

methods.name: uci_revert_state
methods.description: Reverts state changes for a package and optional section/option.

methods.name: uci_set_state
methods.description: Sets a specific state value for a package, section, and option.

methods.name: uci_toggle_state
methods.description: Reverts and then sets a state value, effectively toggling a specific configuration.

methods.name: uci_add_list
methods.description: Adds an item to a configuration list.

methods.name: uci_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value from the state directory.

methods.name: uci_get
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value, with a default fallback if not found.

methods.name: uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new configuration section or sets its type.

methods.name: uci_rename
methods.description: Renames a configuration option or value.

methods.name: uci_remove
methods.description: Removes a configuration section or option.

methods.name: uci_remove_list
methods.description: Removes an item from a list configuration.

methods.name: uci_revert
methods.description: Reverts changes for a package, section, or option.

methods.name: uci_commit
methods.description: Commits changes to the specified package.
